metadata.title: Where Colorado's housing tax credits go, 2016-2026
metadata.index_note: index_9 = a county's (or region's) share of Colorado's 9% federal credit divided by its share of Colorado renter households paying 50% or more of income for rent. 1.0 = the state rate.
metadata.credit_note: credit_9, credit_4 and state_credit are the yearly credit amounts CHFA prints, added up over every award; they are not 10-year totals.
metadata.homes_note: Homes are the income-restricted rental homes CHFA prints for each award (total homes where restricted is blank). homes_4 adds 4% bond deals CHFA awarded outside its rounds (homes_4_outside_rounds): properties on CHFA's tax credit list with a 4% award year in the window that no round award accounts for (matchBondDeals in scripts/funding/build_funding_vs_need.mjs). Those carry homes but no credit amount.
